work_dir.description: The directory where the domain data is stored.

uid.description: User to drop privileges to once all listen-sockets are bound.

gid.description: Group to drop privileges to once all listen-sockets are bound.

listen_addresses.description: Listen addresses. ixfrdist will listen on both UDP and TCP.

allowed_acls.description: Netmasks or IP addresses of hosts that are allowed to query ixfrdist.

axfr_max_records.description: Maximum number of records allowed in a single zone. 0 means unlimited.

axfr_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds an AXFR transaction requested by ixfrdist may take.

failed_soa_retry.description: Time in seconds between retries of the SOA query for a zone we have never transferred.

compress.description: Whether record compression should be enabled.

keep.description: Amount of older copies/IXFR diffs to keep for every domain.

tcp_in_threads.description: Number of threads to spawn for TCP connections (AXFRs) from downstream hosts.

webserver_address.description: The IP address and port where the webserver should listen. Empty string disables it.

webserver_acls.description: The IP address(masks) that allowed to access the webserver.
